node.title: Re: Onkeyup not working
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I agree with what [Corion] [id://11154848|said] that you should use a templating system such as [mod://Mojo::Template], especially given your [id://11154866|reply] further down in the thread.

But you should also look into new HTML5 [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/email|<input type="email">].

And don't rely on any validation that may have been done in the browser because it is very easy to bypass. Always validate on the server side. See [doc://perlfaq9#How-do-I-check-a-valid-mail-address].
